description.text: Remarks: This program is avalaible for senior Scholars as advanced studies. Senior Scholars for advanced studies must complete relevant courses and programs in one year and will receive an advanced studies certificate.

duration.text: The Non-ferrous Metallurgy at University of Science and Technology Beijing is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5777 USD/per year ￥ 41600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Recommendation letter From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 8. A letter from a sponsor

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be under the age of 45; 2. Applicants should hold a Master's degree or above; 3. HSK score should be Level 6 or above.
